newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to struggle with 115-00 barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to struggle with 115-00 barrier.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE need to gather momentum to break the upside barrier of 115-00, but in the meantime the market remains rangebound, technical analysts said on Friday.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said the chart picture for gilts was almost entirely neutral but there was a slight upward bias in the broader sideways range.

"Although it might have a punch at 115-00, I don't really think it has the strength to make much of an upside break," said Gifford. She cited support initially at 114-18, the low on Thursday. At 0700 GMT, September gilts opened 2/32 up at 114-27.
Gifford said below 114-18, September gilts also had support extending through 114-07 and 114-00.
Traders said Friday's session was likely to be relatively quiet with much of continental Europe closed for holiday to mark Assumption Day.
Nico Bakker, technical analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare-Govett in Amsterdam, said said upward potental was growing for gilts but a break of 114-30 was needed to confirm this.
"We need to see more confirmation to enter the market on the long side. I would wait and see a break of 114-30," he said. It would then head towards the 116-02 peak set at the end of July.
On the downside Bakker saw support mainly at 114-07.
At the short end, December short sterling stood unchanged on the day at 92.65.
